## Constraints & Preferences
- Each number (5, 7, 50, 75) must be used at most once.
- The operations +, -, *, and ÷ are allowed.
- Intermediate results must not equal 250.
- The final result must equal 256.

- The user confirmed that the puzzle has no solution.
